run_download_dataset_by_name: run the script to download a specific Nevis dataset by name using --dataset flag
run_download_dataset_by_stream: run the script to download all datasets in a Nevis stream using --stream flag
run_download_with_force_extraction: run the download script with --force_extraction to re-extract an already extracted dataset
run_download_with_statistics: run the download script with --compute_statistics to compute and add dataset statistics to metadata
run_download_with_artifact_cleanup: run the download script with --clean_artifacts_on_completion to remove downloaded artifacts after processing
